extracted_concepts.name: Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A quantity with magnitude and direction, represented as ⟨a, b, c⟩

extracted_concepts.name: Magnitude
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Length of a vector calculated as √(a² + b² + c²)

extracted_concepts.name: Direction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Orientation of a vector in space

extracted_concepts.name: Vector Addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Component-wise sum of two vectors u + v = ⟨u₁+v₁, u₂+v₂, u₃+v₃⟩

extracted_concepts.name: Scalar Multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Multiplying a vector by a scalar cv = ⟨ca, cb, cc⟩

extracted_concepts.name: Dot Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar product u · v = u₁v₁ + u₂v₂ + u₃v₃ = |u||v|cos θ

extracted_concepts.name: Cross Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector product yielding a perpendicular result u × v = ⟨u₂v₃-u₃v₂, ...⟩

extracted_concepts.name: Partial Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a multivariable function with respect to one variable holding others constant

extracted_concepts.name: Gradient
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector of partial derivatives grad f = (∂f/∂x, ∂f/∂y)

extracted_concepts.name: Directional Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change of f in direction u, calculated as D_u f = ∇f · u

extracted_concepts.name: Multivariable Chain Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Formula for total derivative dz/dt = ∂f/∂x · dx/dt + ∂f/∂y · dy/dt

extracted_concepts.name: Lagrange Multipliers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method to optimize f subject to g(x,y)=0 using ∇f = λ∇g

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding maximum or minimum values of a function under constraints

extracted_concepts.name: Projection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measurement of how much one vector aligns with another via dot product

extracted_concepts.name: Perpendicular Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector orthogonal to the plane formed by two input vectors

extracted_concepts.name: Steepest Ascent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Direction of maximum increase of a function, given by the gradient

extracted_concepts.name: Single-variable Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiation process extended to multiple variables via partial derivatives

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: How quickly a function value changes with respect to its inputs

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Direction Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector of length 1 used to specify direction in directional derivatives

extracted_concepts.name: Constraint Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation g(x,y)=0 defining the feasible region for optimization

extracted_relations.evidence: The cross product gives a perpendicular vector
Partial derivatives extend single-variable differentiation to multiple variables
Gradient pointing in the direction of steepest ascent
The gradient unifies direction, rate of change, and optimization
D_u f = ∇f · u (dot product with unit direction vector)
Uses unit direction vector u in calculation
To optimize f(x,y) subject to g(x,y) = 0
Optimization relies on analyzing rates of change via gradients
